---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

billboard_long <- tidyr::billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(week = as.numeric(week)) |>
  filter(week <= 20)

ggplot(billboard_long, aes(
  x = week,
  y = rank,
  group = track,
  color = artist
)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  labs(
    title = "The Race to the Top of the Billboard Charts",
    subtitle = "How songs move through the charts over 20 weeks",
    x = "Weeks on Billboard",
    y = "Chart Position",
    color = "Artist"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```
